# collision.types: ShapeCastResult3D

**Status:** Experimental (tier `future`). Aspirational vocabulary. It must parse and type-check; it is not linted or converted to C#.

## Summary

> The result of sweeping a shape through space. Hit says whether anything was
> struck; Fraction is the normalized sweep parameter in \[0, 1\] at first
> contact; Position and Normal describe the world hit point in meters and the
> surface normal there; BodyIndex is the struck body (-1 = none).
